info.name: AMLOK API 1.0.0
info.description: 65-operation product API contract. Set the institution-issued base_url and API key in a private environment. All sample identifiers are synthetic. Fresh command_reference for each new action; preserve it for retries.

request.description: Register a business or consumer borrower. Registration records institution-supplied identity; it does not assert successful KYB or KYC. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:write.

originalRequest.description: Register a business or consumer borrower. Registration records institution-supplied identity; it does not assert successful KYB or KYC. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:write.

request.description: List borrower. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:read.

originalRequest.description: List borrower. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:read.

request.description: Get borrower. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:read.

originalRequest.description: Get borrower. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: borrowers:read.

request.description: Create a short-lived Integrations Hub session. Send only launch_url to the borrower. AMLOK captures consent and manages provider authorization and ingestion. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:write.

originalRequest.description: Create a short-lived Integrations Hub session. Send only launch_url to the borrower. AMLOK captures consent and manages provider authorization and ingestion. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:write.

request.description: Inspect the borrower-specific execution of a Hub configured in the console. Session completion confirms connection setup, not ingestion readiness or underwriting completion. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:read.

originalRequest.description: Inspect the borrower-specific execution of a Hub configured in the console. Session completion confirms connection setup, not ingestion readiness or underwriting completion. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:read.

request.description: Inspect borrower-authorized integrations, connection status, ingestion readiness, freshness and coverage. The Hub performs authorization; this endpoint exposes its result without configuring integrations. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:read.

originalRequest.description: Inspect borrower-authorized integrations, connection status, ingestion readiness, freshness and coverage. The Hub performs authorization; this endpoint exposes its result without configuring integrations. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:read.

request.description: Inspect one borrower connection and its collection status. Use a Hub reauthorization session when borrower action is required; no provider credentials are returned. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:read.

request.description: Record withdrawal of authorization and stop future collection covered by that consent. Revocation does not edit historical assessments or serve as a data-deletion command. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: connections:write.

request.description: Upload borrower evidence or documents supporting a lending product or risk policy. Upload creates a new record; it cannot overwrite an existing document. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: evidence:write.

request.description: Issue a short-lived download URL for an authorized available file. Recheck source entitlement and borrower access; possession of a document ID alone grants nothing. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: evidence:read.

request.description: Retrieve an underwriting request, its immutable submitted application, product and policy versions, document associations, requirements, status and risk-package reference, including before processing completes. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: insights:read.

request.description: Retrieve an immutable Insights or Signal result with financial dimensions, policy evaluations, limitations and the frozen supporting evidence set. Recommendations do not replace the institution decision. All IDs and cursors must belong to the authorized workspace and environment. Required scope: results:read. Use view=summary for the section index, or view=section with section/cursor/limit for bounded detail. Invalid parameter combinations return 400 validation_error. Full or single-item responses above max_response_bytes return 413 response_too_large with an export source; no fields are silently omitted.

item.name: Simulate a change in a run

request.description: Affects only resources owned by this run. Funding is synthetic and requires Owner billing authority. Receipt changes publish new normalized data versions. Evaluation advances the selected monitor to its next evaluation immediately without changing server time, token expiry or billing periods. resume_credits clears the explicit insufficient-credit test condition after simulated funding. See [Sandbox scenarios](/api-reference/sandbox-journeys) for permissions, fixture coverage, expected results, delivery controls and limitations. The autopay payment outcome tests a synthetic balance of CAD 199 against a CAD 200 threshold, creating a CAD 1,000 simulated top-up. It does not change saved auto-pay settings or deduct funds to force the actual Sandbox balance below the threshold. Source changes require connections:write; evaluation requires signal:write; credit recovery requires insights:write and Owner billing authority.
